news_cards.title: Kendra sarkar ne GOBARdhan yojana ko mana
bullets: Bullet 1: Kendra sarkar ne GOBARdhan yojana ko mana, ismein compressed biogas banane ke liye 23,731 crore rupee ka outlay hai
Bullet 2: Is yojana ke tahat kendra sarkar gaon-gaon mein biogas sansthan lagane ja rahi hai
Bullet 3: Is yojana ka uddeshya gaon ki swachhta aur urja ki samasya ko hal karna hai

news_cards.title: Agni-4 missile ka safal parikshan
bullets: Bullet 1: Bharat ne Agni-4 missile ka safal parikshan kiya, yeh missile 4000 kilometer ki doori tak maara kar sakti hai
Bullet 2: Agni-4 missile ki mark kshamta 4000 kilometer hai, yeh ek madhyam doori ki ballistic missile hai
Bullet 3: Is missile ke parikshan se Bharat ki raksha kshamta badh gayi hai

news_cards.title: RBI ne loan recovery ke liye naye niyam jari kiye
bullets: Bullet 1: RBI ne loan recovery ke liye naye niyam jari kiye, ab bank loan nahi chukane par phone band nahi kar sakte
Bullet 2: RBI ne loan recovery agent ko phone band karne ki anumati nahi di hai
Bullet 3: Is niyam se loan lekar logon ko rahat milegi

news_cards.title: BRICS deshon ka sanskriti sammelan
bullets: Bullet 1: BRICS deshon ka sanskriti sammelan Bhopal mein aayojit kiya gaya
Bullet 2: Is sammelan mein BRICS deshon ke sanskriti mantri shamil hue
Bullet 3: Is sammelan ka uddeshya BRICS deshon ke beech sanskritik samvad ko badhava dena hai

news_cards.title: Kumbhalgarh Tiger Reserve ki sthiti
bullets: Bullet 1: Kumbhalgarh Tiger Reserve ki sthiti sanvedansheel hai, yahaan vanyon ke vicharan mein badhotari hai
Bullet 2: Is tiger reserve mein vanyon ki sankhya badh rahi hai
Bullet 3: Is tiger reserve ki raksha ke liye kadi karyavahi ki jarurat hai
